summary: Open-source contribution contest: build or improve Cognee integrations for AI agent memory via merged pull requests, each paired with a short blog post.
eligibility: Open to anyone, anywhere, subject to local law and shipping limits. Individual entries only.
title: Mergetober 2026 with Cognee

notes: Prize figures inconsistent on the listing; PRs must be opened in October.
